description: Only features derivable from the current MindScan saved task responses and live transcription measurements. No demographics, MRI values, clinician scores, diagnostic labels, or inferred measurements are included.

cognitive_tasks.description: Counts and reaction time computed from saved memory, attention, orientation, and language task responses.

features.name: memory_recall_count
features.source: saved memory words shown and recalled

speech.description: Transcript and timing features emitted by the current successful faster-whisper pipeline. Timing features are nullable unless supported by valid decoded audio and segment timestamps.

features.name: voice_speaking_duration_seconds
features.source: union of valid transcription segment intervals

features.name: voice_speech_rate_words_per_minute
features.source: word count divided by valid timed speech duration

features.name: voice_pause_count
features.source: positive gaps between valid transcription segments

features.name: voice_mean_pause_seconds
features.source: mean positive gap between valid transcription segments

features.name: voice_maximum_pause_seconds
features.source: maximum positive gap between valid transcription segments

features.name: voice_estimated_non_speech_ratio
features.source: audio duration minus summed transcription segment duration; not waveform silence detection

features.name: voice_filler_word_count
features.source: English filler-token count; unavailable for other detected languages

features.name: voice_filler_word_ratio_percent
features.source: English filler-token count divided by transcript word count; unavailable for empty or other-language transcripts

features.name: voice_lexical_diversity
features.source: unique transcript tokens divided by transcript token count
